title: Cloud City: CI/CD & Release Engineering: Cloud Build, Deploy & DORA
city_concept: City Municipal Printing Press & Delivery Fleets

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Newspaper delivery boys were printing unverified rumors and distributing them directly to town doorsteps, causing riots.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Master Printer Paul established the Editorial Press Line (CI/CD): writers submit stories to editors, fact-checkers verify sources, and only approved papers are loaded onto wagons.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When an error slipped into the morning edition, Paul sent a boy on a bicycle to replace the front page before wagons reached Main Street (Canary Rollback).

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical paper printing cannot be retracted once read; digital cloud deployments can be rolled back in seconds with zero downtime.
